_comment: Indicators of compromise for developer-targeted malware. Bundled seed list; drop an updated copy at ~/.mrclean/iocs.json to extend it (entries are merged). Sources: Datadog Security Labs, Unit 42, Red Canary, Microsoft Security Blog, Aikido/Socket write-ups (2025). script_markers: the EtherHiding loader that a compromised contributor force-pushed into a pull request here (Oct 2026); it reads its server address from Ethereum transactions sent by the wallet below.

home_paths.malware: Shai-Hulud 2.0 (self-hosted GitHub runner used as a backdoor)

runtime_advisories.name: Node2Shell
runtime_advisories.summary: Its built-in Brotli decoder can be made to write past a buffer, so any program that unpacks Brotli data from the internet (fetch(), Express 5, body-parser 2) can be taken over remotely. Fixed in Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1 (21 October 2026).

runtime_advisories.name: Node2Shell
runtime_advisories.summary: Bun bundles the same Brotli decoder bug as Node.js, so a crafted Brotli response or request can take over a program running on it. Fixed in Bun 1.4.4.
